review.posthog_relevance: Changes account-scoped Twilio warehouse ingestion configuration, including authentication token handling, account metadata, and endpoint configuration, while retaining warehouse ingestion capabilities.
review.reason: The chunk removes Twilio subaccount-specific settings and replaces them with account-scoped settings, including account SID and owner account SID. It also adds account-specific endpoint configuration and excludes sensitive authentication tokens from warehouse rows. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement in warehouse ingestion and account resource management.
